capture_contract.reference: Each trace's top-level capture fields contain the reference capture.
capture_contract.candidate: trace.candidate is a second object with status='captured' and every capture field listed below. Both captures come from independent executions of the same pinned execution identity.

field_types.config_canonical_sha256: 64 lowercase hex; SHA-256 of canonical config bytes
field_types.payload_sha256: object with exactly state_t0, committed_steps, reset, probe; each value is SHA-256 of that capture's raw file
field_types.provider: nonempty complete provider/version/library identity string from the capture
field_types.compiler: nonempty complete compiler/version/target/options identity string from the capture
field_types.command: nonempty array of nonempty argv strings; record actual invocation, never execute it in this test
field_types.capture_id: nonempty independent invocation identifier; reference differs from candidate
field_types.source_sha: 40 lowercase hex; equal to manifest.base_sha and S00 baseline.base_sha
field_types.executable_sha256: 64 lowercase hex; equal for reference and candidate
field_types.execution_identity_sha256: 64 lowercase hex; same full execution identity in reference and candidate

capture_contract.payload_format: Raw contiguous IEEE-754 binary64, little endian (no text rounding). Each of the four stage payloads must contain at least one element. Stage-specific lengths may differ, but each reference/candidate pair has the same length.
capture_contract.path_policy: All eight stage files of each trace and files from other traces/platforms are separate regular files; canonical aliases and hard links are rejected.
capture_contract.comparison: Exactly two platform records, exactly flat/rough_uphill_savage.toml/alpine_rocky.toml for each. Compare only a reference/candidate pair from one platform and one identity, never one platform against another. SHA-256 checked per file; values compared by uint64_t object representation.
capture_contract.pending_policy: All capture fields and base_sha remain null until V01 captures real data. Missing/null identity or payload is a failure, never a skip. Capture status becomes captured once materialized; this does not by itself mean verified.
capture_contract.scope: This manifest establishes repeatable planar baseline traces on the S00 source. Subsequent integration comparisons must retain the applicable execution/provider contract rather than silently recapturing expected values from changed physics.
